notes.title: New Monster + Server Regions + Misc Changes
notes.content:
[b]Things added:[/b]
Added a region selector, solving the issue of some players being unable to connect with others
Added a new enemy, Bacteria
New bugs added :)

[b]Problems fixed:[/b]
All bugs related to the inventory have been corrected
Issues where some players couldn't load certain scenes
Problems related to the hideout locker resolved (I hope...)

[b]Changes in this version:[/b]
The entire multiplayer has been redone, so please leave your feedback if you encounter any bugs
Removed the enemy chase sound (I'm unsure if I should add it back) - give me your opinion
Removed the black screen when all players are dead
As I've redone a lot of things to maintain updates more smoothly, I ended up fixing and changing some things, so please report any bugs you find on our Discord

[b]Known issues:[/b]
If the server disconnects, some things may go out of control, this will be fixed soon

Next update:
New level and a new monster

Special thanks to buttery stancakes for the feedback since the game became available in the store

notes.title: The Lobby Level Update
notes.content:
After feedback from the community, I decided to remake The Lobby scenario for a smaller scenario, the new scenario reduced the difficulty and made the gameplay more fluid.

New monsters and maps will be arriving soon!

Merry Christmas everyone!
